report.coverage: Unchanged AIRI queries and gold ids; default production SQL, threshold, ranking and query normalization. Twenty approved fixture documents per language. Only zh-to-en uses the English corpus. Gold labels never enter embedding input or retrieval.
report.failurePolicy: Stop on the first transport, admission, storage or protocol failure; no retry. Individual relevance misses are measurements, and the frozen aggregate thresholds decide acceptance after all 90 cases. Self-test is wiring evidence only.

diagnosis.conclusion: The production 3-second optional-vector interaction deadline fired while the second query request had received HTTP 200 headers but no complete validated vector. The database remained ready. No chat request occurred, and S16/S20 real answers were not reached.
diagnosis.limit: This confirms the cutoff for this window. It does not establish provider-side slowness versus local/network response-body delay, and does not recover the missing error from the older window.
